betterhotbarswap.settings.title: BetterHotbarSwap Settings
betterhotbarswap.settings.hotbar_priorit: When you send an item from your inventory to an OCCUPIED hotbar slot with a hotkey, the old item does not go to your inventory: it first stacks with the same item in your hotbar, otherwise it moves to the nearest empty hotbar slot. When off, the two items swap like vanilla. Taking from chests or crafting outputs always uses this rule.
betterhotbarswap.settings.shift_hotbar_p: In crafting screens (crafting table, stonecutter, smithing table...), hover the result and press Shift + a hotkey: everything you can craft goes to that hotbar slot in one go (spilling into neighbouring slots when full). When off, only the visible result is taken.
betterhotbarswap.settings.tidy_collect.d: In storage (chests, barrels, shulker boxes...), hold Shift + a hotkey and Shift-click items (or sweep the mouse over them). Items fill from that hotbar slot to the right, then your inventory. Hotbar slots to the left of it are never touched.
betterhotbarswap.settings.survival_toolb: Save key (default N) + hotkey: saves your whole layout (hotbar, inventory, offhand). Load key (default M) + hotkey: items are MOVED back to where you saved them, missing ones are skipped. Nothing is ever copied. These keys work in every mode including Creative; in Survival the vanilla C/X keys do the same.
betterhotbarswap.settings.debug.desc: Developer tool: lists every action of the mod in the top-left corner and writes it to the log file. Turn it on when reporting a bug; keep it off for normal play.
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.title: Saved Toolbars
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.edit_hint: Click a toolbar to edit it
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.edit_help: Drag and drop or click to move items; it only rearranges, nothing is duplicated. Red: not in your inventory right now.
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.add.desc: Saves your current layout (hotbar, inventory and offhand) into the first free slot.
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.full: All 9 slots are used, delete one first.
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.none: No toolbars yet. Add one below.
betterhotbarswap.toolbar.hint: In world: %s+Hotkey to save, %s+Hotkey to load
betterhotbarswap.msg.no_room: No room — free up some inventory space.
betterhotbarswap.msg.stalled: Pickup got stuck — empty your cursor and reopen the screen.
